description: Manually labelled scientific retrieval queries with evidence provenance ground truth.

corpus.paper_title: Domain Adaptation in Low-Resource Scientific NLP
corpus.text: Cross-domain generalization degrades substantially when evaluating the model on out-of-distribution biomedical abstracts without target domain adaptation.

corpus.paper_title: Domain Adaptation in Low-Resource Scientific NLP
corpus.text: We apply adversarial domain discrimination with gradient reversal layers to align source and target latent feature distributions.

corpus.paper_title: Efficient Attention Mechanisms for Long-Context Scientific Retrieval
corpus.text: The quadratic computational complexity and peak GPU memory overhead of vanilla self-attention severely constrain maximum context lengths beyond 8k tokens.

corpus.paper_title: Efficient Attention Mechanisms for Long-Context Scientific Retrieval
corpus.text: FlashAttention-2 reduces peak memory consumption by 65 percent while accelerating throughput by 2.4x across 16k context lengths.

corpus.paper_title: Multimodal Evidence Extraction from Clinical Case Reports
corpus.text: The acute scarcity of expert-annotated clinical datasets and medical imaging pairs poses significant risk of overfitting in multi-task training.

corpus.paper_title: Multimodal Evidence Extraction from Clinical Case Reports
corpus.text: Future research should explore zero-shot vision-language models and semi-supervised pseudolabeling to mitigate annotated clinical data shortages.

corpus.paper_title: Robustness and Evaluation Bias in Scientific Text Summarization
corpus.text: Standard n-gram overlap metrics such as ROUGE exhibit substantial lexical bias and fail to penalize factual hallucinations in generated summaries.

corpus.paper_title: Robustness and Evaluation Bias in Scientific Text Summarization
corpus.text: We introduce FactScore-Sci, an entailing sentence decomposition framework that checks atomic factual claims against source research papers.

corpus.paper_title: Contrastive Representation Learning for Scientific Citation Graphs
corpus.text: Uniform random negative sampling in graph contrastive learning produces false negatives due to high citation homophily in dense subfields.

corpus.paper_title: Contrastive Representation Learning for Scientific Citation Graphs
corpus.text: Hard negative mining guided by co-citation proximity yields a 4.2 percent gain in mean reciprocal rank on downstream paper recommendation.
